Name: Blue Jay
Description: Blue jays are loud, bold, and far smarter than their reputation suggests. They mimic the calls of hawks, remember thousands of hiding places, and — by burying acorns and forgetting some — plant whole oak forests. Their blue is not pigment at all but light scattered through feather structure.
CreationReflection: The jay plants trees it will never sit beneath. Much of the Christian life is like that: sowing in faith, trusting God with a harvest we may never see.
Habitat: Oak woodlands, parks, and suburbs across eastern and central North America.
